description: Persisted target-to-book provenance. Normal builds validate this file and do not parse source PDFs.

method.pageNumbering: Printed book pages; printed page 3 is PDF page 4.
method.targetMatch: First exact normalized text hit within the audited chapter; folded OCR match is used only when exact text is absent.
method.fallback: chapter-range means OCR did not expose an exact target token; the audited chapter range remains authoritative.
method.refreshRule: Run the manual refresh only when a full-text source PDF hash changes or the frozen inventory is revised.
